messages.subject: blur ratio and excess attenuation
parts:
Hi all

when working with signal degradation: has anyone used seewave to calculate "blur ratio" and "excess attenuation" (for instance as defined by Dabelsteen et al in this paper)?. The formulas are not totally clear in the paper, so I would like to know if someone has been able to translate/implement them into R.

cheers

Marcelo
